camel_example: aliyun esa ListCacheReserveInstances --region cn-hangzhou --Status online --PageSize 20 --PageNumber 1 --InstanceId 'sp-xcdn-96wblslz0000' --SortBy ExpireTime --SortOrder desc
description_en: Queries the list of cache reserve instances for the current user
description_zh: 查询当前用户的缓存保持实例列表
kebab_example: aliyun esa list-cache-reserve-instances --status online --sort-by ExpireTime --sort-order desc --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --instance-id sp-xcdn-96wblslz0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCacheReserveInstances

parameters.help_en:
The instance status of the cache reserve instance. Valid values:

online: Normal service status.
offline: The instance expires but has not exceeded the retention period and is unavailable.
disable: The instance has been released.
overdue: The instance is stopped due to an overdue payment
parameters.help_zh:
缓存保持实例状态。支持：

online：正常服务状态。
offline：到期但未超期，处于不可用的状态。
disable：已释放状态。
overdue：欠费停机状态
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The sort field. Valid values:
ExpireTime: sorts by expiration time.
CreateTime: sorts by creation time
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式。取值：
ExpireTime：过期时间。
CreateTime：新购时间
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:
asc: ascending order.
desc: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式。支持：
asc：升序。
desc：降序
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 500. Default value: 500
parameters.name: page_size

InstanceInfo.description_en: The list of cache reserve instances

items.description_en: The details of a cache reserve instance

CacheReserveCapacity.description_en: The capacity of the cache reserve instance. Unit: GB

CacheReserveRegion.description_en: The region where the cache reserve instance is deployed

ChargeType.description_en:
The billing type. Valid values:
PREPAY: subscription.
POSTPAY: pay-as-you-go
ChargeType.description_zh:
计费类型
PREPAY：预付费。
POSTPAY：后付费

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the instance

Duration.description_en: The subscription duration of the instance. Unit: months
Duration.description_zh: 实例的购买时长，单位：月

ExpireTime.description_en: The time when the instance expires

Status.description_en:
The instance status. Valid values:
online: The instance is running normally.
offline: The instance has expired but has not exceeded the retention period and is unavailable.
disable: The instance has been released.
overdue: The instance is stopped due to an overdue payment
Status.description_zh:
实例状态。取值：
online：正常服务状态。
offline：到期但未超期，处于不可用的状态。
disable：已释放状态。
overdue：欠费停服状态

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 500. Valid values: 1 to 500
